description:
Every pound the `test_order` plan moves, month by month.

Takes the same `profile`, `regime_state` and `corridor_id` as `test_order`
and builds the same plan without re-solving it, so cash lines and cost lines
agree with that plan. `months` is monthly, the grain the plan is solved at.
`ledgered: false` with `missing` means no plan exists for this profile.

Figures carry a `provenance` stamp (READ, MEASURED, DERIVED, COMPUTED, PROXY or ESTIMATED; defined in the server instructions) and a `basis`; `missing` names any figure only the caller holds. Information, not advice.
name: plan_ledger
title: Plan ledger, month by month
